entries.title: Matthew 10:1
segments: Calling his twelve Disciples to him, Jesus gave them authority over foul spirits, so that they could drive them out, as well as the power of curing every kind of disease and every kind of sickness.

entries.title: Matthew 10:2
segments: The names of the twelve Apostles are these: First Simon, also known as Peter, and his brother Andrew; James the son of Zebediah, and his brother John;

entries.title: Matthew 10:3
segments: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax-gather; James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

entries.title: Matthew 10:4
segments: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot--the Apostle who betrayed him.

entries.title: Matthew 10:5
segments: These twelve Jesus sent out as his Messengers, after giving them these instructions--"Do not go to the Gentiles, nor enter any Samaritan town,

entries.title: Matthew 10:6
segments: But make your way rather to the lost sheep of Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 10:7
segments: And on your way proclaim that the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.

entries.title: Matthew 10:8
segments: Cure the sick, raise the dead, make the lepers clean, drive out demons. You have received free of cost, give free of cost.

entries.title: Matthew 10:9
segments: Do not provide yourselves with gold, or silver, or pence in your purses;

entries.title: Matthew 10:10
segments: Not even with a bag for the journey, or a change of clothes, or sandals, or even a staff; for the worker is worth his food.

entries.title: Matthew 10:11
segments: Whatever town or village you visit, find out who is worthy in that place, and remain there till you leave.

entries.title: Matthew 10:12
segments: As you enter the house, greet it.

entries.title: Matthew 10:13
segments: Then, if the house is worthy, let your blessing rest upon it, but, if it is unworthy, let your blessing return upon yourselves.

entries.title: Matthew 10:14
segments: If no one welcomes you, or listens to what you say, as you leave that house or that town, shake off its dust from your feet.

entries.title: Matthew 10:15
segments: I tell you, the doom of the land of Sodom and Gomorrah will be more bearable in the 'Day of Judgement' than the doom of that town.

entries.title: Matthew 10:16
segments: Remember, I am sending you out as my Messengers like sheep among wolves. So be as wise as serpents, and as blameless as doves.

entries.title: Matthew 10:17
segments: Be on your guard against your fellow men, for they will betray you to courts of law, and scourge you in their Synagogues;

entries.title: Matthew 10:18
segments: And you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, that you may witness for me before them and the nations.

entries.title: Matthew 10:19
segments: Whenever they betray you, do not be anxious as to how you shall speak or what you shall say, for what you shall say will be given you at the moment;

entries.title: Matthew 10:20
segments: For it will not be you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father that speaks within you.

entries.title: Matthew 10:21
segments: Brother will betray brother to death, and the father his child; and children will turn against their parents, and cause them to be put to death;

entries.title: Matthew 10:22
segments: And you will be hated by every one on account of my Name. Yet the man that endures to the end shall be saved.

entries.title: Matthew 10:23
segments: But, when they persecute you in one town, escape to the next; for, I tell you, you will not have come to the end of the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.

entries.title: Matthew 10:24
segments: A scholar is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.

entries.title: Matthew 10:25
segments: It is enough for a scholar to be treated like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Baal-zebub, how much more the members of his household!

entries.title: Matthew 10:26
segments: Do not, therefore, be afraid of them. There is nothing concealed which will not be revealed, nor anything hidden which will not become known.

entries.title: Matthew 10:27
segments: What I tell you in the dark, say again in the light; and what is whispered in your ear, proclaim upon the housetops.

entries.title: Matthew 10:28
segments: And do not be afraid of those who kill the body, but are unable to kill the soul; rather be afraid of him who is able to destroy both soul and body in the Pit.

entries.title: Matthew 10:29
segments: Are not two sparrows sold for a half-penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground without your Father's knowledge.

entries.title: Matthew 10:30
segments: While as for you, the very hairs of your head are numbered.

entries.title: Matthew 10:31
segments: Do not, therefore, be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.

entries.title: Matthew 10:32
segments: Every one, therefore, who shall acknowledge me before his fellow men, I, too, will acknowledge before my Father who is in Heaven;

entries.title: Matthew 10:33
segments: But, if any one disowns me before his fellow men, I, too, will disown him before my Father who is in Heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 10:34
segments: Do not imagine that I have come to bring peace upon the earth. I have come to bring, not peace, but the sword.

entries.title: Matthew 10:35
segments: For I have come to set--'a man against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

entries.title: Matthew 10:36
segments: A man's enemies will be the members of his own household.'

entries.title: Matthew 10:37
segments: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

entries.title: Matthew 10:38
segments: And the man who does not take his cross and follow in my steps is not worthy of me.

entries.title: Matthew 10:39
segments: He who has found his life will lose it, while he who, for my sake, has lost his life shall find it.

entries.title: Matthew 10:40
segments: He who welcomes you is welcoming me; and he who welcomes me is welcoming him who sent me as his Messenger.

entries.title: Matthew 10:41
segments: He who welcomes a Prophet, because he is a Prophet, shall receive a Prophet's reward; and he who welcomes a good man, because he is a good man, shall receive a good man's reward.

entries.title: Matthew 10:42
segments: And, if any one gives but a cup of cold water to one of these lowly ones because he is a disciple, I tell you that he shall assuredly not lose his reward."
